name: Firozpur

queries.query: Firozpur Punjab official cadastral parcel map land records GIS portal site:gov.in
queries.result: Found Punjab Government's official Bhu-Naksha viewer, Punjab Land Records cadastral map, and DILRMP district status. The DILRMP page reports Firozpur district cadastral and parcel coverage, but is status evidence rather than a parcel API.

queries.query: ਫਿਰੋਜ਼ਪੁਰ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਨਕਸ਼ਾ ਕੈਡਸਟ੍ਰਲ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਪੋਰਟਲ
queries.result: Found the Punjabi-language Punjab Land Records cadastral map and Punjabi Bhu-Naksha viewer. The official viewer exposed Punjabi administrative selectors including ਫਿਰੋਜਪੁਰ and ਫਿਰੋਜਪੁਰ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ.

registry.custodian: Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab, India; Director, Land Records, Punjab
registry.service: Punjab Bhu-Naksha public cadastral map viewer
registry.scope: State viewer with district, tehsil, kanungo, patwar and village map navigation; data is explicitly marked provisional and for viewing only.

extentRequest.crs: Not declared in response; coordinates are native projected viewer coordinates and were not transformed or used as WUP coordinates.

parcelEvidence.reason: The viewer route resolved a bounded village extent but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry payload was obtained. No exact-point hit or citywide absence is inferred.
parcelEvidence.qualification: Not admitted as a runtime parcel adapter; serial review required.

researchNotes: Official JavaScript/config inspection found rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS routes.
ListsAfterLevel successfully returned Punjabi administrative codes and labels; the bounded extent request returned HTTP 200 for the resolved path.
A shorter/incomplete extent path returned HTTP 500, and the WMS GetCapabilities request returned an empty response; these are recorded as route limitations, not absence evidence.
Only safe administrative and map metadata were requested. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or personal fields were requested.
